description:
Job Title: Appian Configuration Analyst - Junior Developer 
 
Job Category: Engineering 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25% 
 
Type of Travel: Continental US 
 
* * * 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
CACI is preparing for an exciting modernization effort with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). This new program will be a transformational initiative that will reshape how the VA manages acquisition, contracting, and enterprise-wide data. As the VA moves toward a modern, secure, and integrated CMS environment, our team will play a pivotal role in delivering the technology, expertise, and innovative problem solving required to support the nation’s veterans.
  
 CACI is building a team of experts who thrive in challenging modernization environments as this program calls for high-impact technical leaders, forward-thinking engineers and mission-focused professionals. We are currently hiring an Appian Configuration Analyst (Junior Developer) to join this dynamic team.
  
 The Appian Configuration Analyst (Junior Developer) will configure and optimize Appian-based solutions within Agile delivery pods supporting an enterprise acquisition system modernization. This role requires strong technical skills in low-code platform configuration, experience with business process automation, and the ability to work collaboratively with developers and business analysts to deliver user-friendly workflows serving 26,000+ users transitioning to a unified Appian-based platform.

 This position is contingent upon contract award. 

 Responsibilities: 
 Configure Appian GAM Suite modules including workflows, business rules, decision tables, forms, interfaces, and user experience components to meet Federal acquisition requirements
 Collaborate with Appian developers, business analysts, and subject matter experts to translate business requirements into technical Appian configurations
 Build and maintain configurable components including clause libraries, questionnaire logic, milestone templates, approval routing, and document generation templates
 Support development of reusable Appian objects, interfaces, data types, and expression rules to accelerate delivery and promote consistency
 Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, demos, and retrospectives, contributing to sprint commitments and velocity
 Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying configuration patterns, reusable components, and process optimizations
 Conduct unit testing of configured components and support integration testing, UAT, and defect resolution activities
 Document configuration decisions, technical specifications, and user-facing guidance to support knowledge transfer and maintenance
 Optimize Appian performance through configuration best practices, caching strategies, and efficient workflow design
 Support deployment activities including package preparation, environment promotion, and release validation
 
 Qualifications: 
 Required:  
 US Citizen with ability to pass Tier 2 background investigation
 Bachelor's degree (preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related technical field), or at least 3 additional years of relevant IT experience
 1-3 years of experience in software configuration, business process automation, or low-code platform development
 Experience with low-code/no-code platforms or business process management tools
 Strong understanding of workflow automation, business rules, and process modeling concepts
 Ability to translate business requirements into technical configurations
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
 
 Desired: 
 Appian Certified Analyst or Appian Certified Associate Developer certification
 Hands-on experience with Appian platform configuration (process models, interfaces, decision rules, records, sites)
 Experience supporting Federal government system modernization programs
 Knowledge of Federal acquisition lifecycle, contracting processes, or FAR/VAAR regulations
 Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and sprint-based delivery
 Prior experience with API integrations, web services, or system interfaces
 SQL knowledge for data querying and validation
 Familiarity with Federal financial management or ERP systems
 Experience with Azure cloud environments or SaaS application configuration
 Background in user experience design or Section 508 accessibility standards
 Scripting or programming experience (JavaScript, Java, Python) for advanced Appian configuration
 
 
 
- 
 

 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$58,000-$115,900 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
